confirmHint: Choose a language or select Continue in this tooltip to keep the current choice.
interfaceBody: Which language would you like for the app and this introduction? Choose another language or keep the current one.
interfaceHint: The app and introduction switch to your choice immediately.
translationBody: Choose a translation language for meanings and examples. It can differ from the interface language. You can also turn translations off.
secondaryMention: You can add a second translation language later in Settings → Languages.
saveError: Could not save this choice. Try again.
localOnly: Preview choices stay in this browser. Your account settings are unchanged.
startBody: Dilum NL already uses material from Dilum Nederlands. You can change its settings later. Start the training to try a card.
revealBody: This is de bank, the word we will study. First, look at the word. Select “Show answer” to turn the card over and see its definition and an example.
finish: This is the end of the preview. Next, the introduction will explain the meaning and the Learn action.
noLearningWrite: This is a preview: learning progress is not recorded.
scope: This preview covers language choices and the first training card.
createLater: Creating a training will be covered later in the introduction.
editLater: Editing a training will be covered later in the introduction.
themeLater: Appearance settings are outside this preview.
learnBody: Read the definition and example. Select Learn to start studying this particular meaning. We will explore other card actions in an additional topic.
exitBody: Your first meaning is now being learned. Close the session to finish the main tour and choose additional topics.
libraryBody: Library lets you find words and choose the meanings you want to practise.
searchBody: We have entered bank for you. Open the result to see its two meanings.
openWordBody: Bank is already entered. Select the result to explore its meanings.
meaningBody: Bank can mean furniture or a financial institution. Open the meaning you need; you will add only that meaning to a collection.
collectionsBody: Open Collections for this meaning. Collections group selected meanings; they do not copy or reset learning progress.
newCollectionBody: Choose an existing collection, or create one to keep this meaning.
collectionNameBody: Give the collection a useful name and create it. The selected meaning will be added.
membershipTitle: The meaning is in your collection
membershipBody: The checked collection contains this meaning. Choose Done to continue; the meaning keeps its learning progress.
goTrainingTitle: Make a training for the collection
goTrainingBody: Return to Training. A collection selects material; a saved training also remembers how you practise it.
createTrainingBody: Create a training for your collection. Your primary Dilum NL training stays available.
sourceBody: Open Source to choose your collection instead of the whole dictionary.
sourcePickBody: Choose the collection you just used. This training will practise its selected meanings.
exercisesBody: Open Exercises. For this first collection training, keep Words and choose Direct.
directionBody: Choose Direct. You see the word first and recall its meaning. Reverse starts with the meaning.
saveTrainingBody: Save the training so you can return to the collection and these exercise settings.
nameTrainingBody: Enter a recognisable name and save. This creates a separate saved training, not a new copy of learning progress.
completeBody: Your saved training remembers the collection and exercise direction. You can edit or launch it here. Dilum NL remains your primary training.
noResults: No demo results. Search for bank.
journeySaved: Saved in this browser only. Account and real learning progress are unchanged.
collectionRequired: Add a meaning to a collection first.
actionHint: Use the highlighted area to continue.
sampleAudio: This preview uses your browser’s voice for pronunciation. Dutch voice availability depends on your device.
audioBody: Select the speaker to hear how de bank is pronounced. Next, we will explore the other meanings of this word.
detailsBody: This card shows one meaning. Select the three dots to open the dictionary article with all meanings of bank.
returnBody: Bank can mean furniture or a financial institution. Expand either meaning here. Close this panel with the cross to return to the card definition.
knownTitle: If you already know the meaning
knownBody: “Mark as known” is an alternative to “Learn” for a meaning you already know. It applies to this meaning, not every meaning of the word.
knownHint: You do not need to select it for this tour. Known status stays unchanged in the preview.
reportBody: The flag button (Report) opens a problem report for translations, card content or application behaviour. Open it to explore the form.
reportDemo: Choose a category and optionally describe the problem. This is a practice form: sending is disabled and text is not saved. Close it with “Back” to finish the tour.
extrasDoneTitle: You have explored the extra actions
extrasDoneBody: This additional topic is complete. Choose another in Settings → Getting started or return to practice.
paused: Tour paused. Resume in Settings → Getting started.
pauseIntro: You can pause this tour. In Settings → Getting started, resume from this step or start again.
resumeHelp: Closing the guidance saves your place. Resume returns to the same step; Start again begins with languages. Collections and saved trainings are kept.
topicHelp: The main tour covers languages and your first card. Choose another topic or explore all in order. Each can be paused and resumed here.
collectionsTopic: Library, collection and your own training
collectionsTopicBody: Find a word, choose a meaning, add it to a collection and save a training based on it.
cardTopicBody: Listen, open all meanings and return; mark a familiar meaning as known or report a problem.
statsTopicBody: Select New or Learning beside a meaning to explore its learning state.
sharingTopicBody: Explore opening and closing access to your collection for other people.
languagesTopicBody: Change interface and translation languages; find out where to add a second language later.
appearanceTopicBody: Open appearance settings and switch between light and dark themes.
basicDoneTitle: Your first meaning is being learned
basicDoneBody: You chose languages, explored a card and started learning a meaning. The main tour is complete. Finish here or choose more topics.
statsBody: This button above the meaning opens its statistics. Select it.
sharingBody: Open sharing management to explore how to share a collection.
sharingExplanation: The collection owner opens access and sends an invitation link or code. Recipients can view the collection. The owner can close access or replace the invitation.
tourComplete: Main tour complete. More topics are in Settings → Getting started.
statsViewBody: This panel shows learning directions, card presentations and reviews. Close it with the cross to continue.
settingsOpenBody: Select the gear at the top of the application.
appearanceChoiceBody: This is where you change the application’s appearance. Choose light, dark or system theme.
appearanceDoneBody: You changed the theme in the regular application settings. Other appearance preferences are here too.
languagesChoiceBody: Interface, translation and additional languages are here. You can change them at any time.
sharingTabBody: In Library, select the Collections tab.
sharingMoreBody: Select the three dots to the right of your collection.
sharingMenuBody: This opens sharing settings for the selected collection.
sharingCreateBody: Select Create view-only link. Another person can use it to add the collection for viewing. This local preview uses demonstration data.
sharingConfirmBody: Read the invitation link/code warning and confirm.
sharingLinkTitle: The link and code are ready
sharingLinkBody: This is where you copy the link or invitation code. Now select Close shared access to explore revoking access.
sharingCloseBody: Read what changes for subscribers, then confirm.
sharingDoneBody: You still own your collection. Close sharing settings with Close.
